event.arrival.text: The airlock closes behind us. Outside lies a red wilderness. Inside the greenhouse, the planting trays need care. We have fourteen Martian days to keep the crew safe and send our research to Earth. Where should we begin?
event.delivery.text: The terminal's transmission light comes on. Research stored here has not yet reached Earth. They need to hear from us. But we also need time for food, rest, and tomorrow.
event.dust.text: Sunlight reaches the panels, but a thin layer of dust blocks it. Cleaning them means giving up today's other work. Waiting will leave us with less power for the days ahead.
event.supply.text: A crew member opens the food cabinet, then looks toward the greenhouse. The plants need care, but research cannot wait forever. Should we spend today with the crops, or keep to our plan?
event.routine.text: The wind sounds distant. Equipment hums quietly inside. Our routine check found no urgent problems. For once, we can choose how to spend the day.
event.sandstorm.text: Dust swallows the distant ridge. Sand keeps tapping against the window. We must stay inside. Dust is settling on the solar panels, so every use of power needs careful thought.

event.E01.title: Three Knocks
event.E01.text: A tapping sound repeats at the hatch. A supply case hangs outside; its strap looks uneven.
event.E01.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E02.title: Clicking Solar Panel
event.E02.text: The panel clicks when it turns. Today it stopped short of its usual position.
event.E02.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E03.title: The Shorter Night
event.E03.text: The battery reads full, but the low-power warning comes earlier despite similar use.
event.E03.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E04.title: The Thirsty Greenhouse
event.E04.text: The display asks for more water, but the growing medium looks damp.
event.E04.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E05.title: The Robot Drops Things
event.E05.text: The robot returns with fewer samples. Its camera shows a rock slipping from its grasp.
event.E05.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E06.title: The Flickering Antenna
event.E06.text: The signal cuts out whenever the antenna moves, then returns when it stops.
event.E06.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E07.title: The Longer Warm Up
event.E07.text: One room warms slowly. The heater runs more often than yesterday.
event.E07.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E08.title: The Whistling Vent
event.E08.text: A vent whistles and the airflow feels weaker.
event.E08.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E09.title: The Sluggish Watering System
event.E09.text: Water arrives at one growing tray later than it used to. The pump keeps running.
event.E09.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E10.title: One Spare Two Failures
event.E10.text: The greenhouse pump flickers. The antenna sometimes refuses to move.
event.E10.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E11.title: Your Experiment Is Dinner
event.E11.text: The crop is ready to eat. Keeping some for science would use food and care time you may need later.
event.E11.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E12.title: Outdated Advice
event.E12.text: Earth says “Do not restart,” but their instructions describe the setup you changed earlier.
event.E12.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E13.title: The Robot Is Stuck
event.E13.text: Your rover has stopped in loose ground with a full sample box. Repeated attempts are draining its battery.
event.E13.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E14.title: An Empty Chair
event.E14.text: Your crewmate asks for a break. A short-lived observation opportunity arrives just as they sit down.
event.E14.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E15.title: The Unlabelled Samples
event.E15.text: A spill has blurred two sample labels. You cannot confidently match them to their collection sites.
event.E15.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E16.title: The Last Day Shortcut
event.E16.text: Your final transmission fails. A greenhouse part could restore the antenna, but the next crew needs that greenhouse.
event.E16.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E17.title: A Spill in the Wrong Place
event.E17.text: A leaking drink pouch has reached the edge of an experiment rack.
event.E17.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E18.title: The Backup Fails Too
event.E18.text: A sharp impact is followed by darkness outside. Both power indicators turn red.
event.E18.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E19.title: The Shelter Decision
event.E19.text: The radiation monitor warns against outdoor work. You can move into the protected area, but the experiment outside will have to wait.
event.E19.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E20.title: The Fading Panels
event.E20.text: The panels look duller than before. Even at midday, the power display climbs more slowly.
event.E20.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
